indexes.//: Payout sweeper: payouts.where(status in [pending, awaiting_setup]).orderBy(createdAt). Firestore requires a composite index whenever an 'in' filter is combined with an orderBy on a different field. Without this the sweeper throws 'The query requires an index' on its first run and no driver is ever paid.
findPendingCashout: payouts.where(uid ==).where(status in [...]). Two equality filters on different fields require a composite index; without it every cashout request 500s.
Account deletion: rides.where(driverId ==).where(status in [planned, started]). An equality filter plus an 'in' on a different field needs a composite index; without it every delete request 500s.
Refunds: users/{uid}/transactions.where(rideId ==).where(type ==). Two equality filters on different fields need a composite index; without it /billing/refund 500s.
